dba_name.value: Hand and Stone Massage and Facial Spa

parent_name.value: Majority-owned by HP H&S Parent Holdings, LP (Harvest Partners-affiliated funds)

business_description.value: Massage, facial, waxing, skincare, and contouring/sculpting services under the Hand and Stone system.

marketing_fund.value: 1% of gross sales to marketing fund; may be increased to 2% (FDD Item 6, p.15)

territory.value: Protected territory (generally <=3 miles and <=50,000 residents); boundaries may be reduced; the franchisee does not receive an exclusive territory (FDD Item 12, p.38)

item20.value: 600 franchised + 15 company-owned = 615 outlets as of FY2025 (FDD Item 20, p.68)

litigation.value: 2 disclosed matters: Muti arbitration (settlement); 2024 Texas matter/crossclaim (FDD Item 3)

net_worth.item: word-boundary grep \b(net worth|liquid capital|liquid assets)\b over 14,043 FDD text lines returned 0 hits

item19.value: quartile gross sales for 570 franchised outlets
item19.item: FDD Item 19 — 570 full-year franchised outlets + 15 corporate spas; quartile average gross sales: top $2,277,452; second $1,469,435; third $1,042,031; bottom $627,439 (gross sales only; no cost or profit figures)

logo_url.item: 2026-09-15 HTTP 200, image/webp, 2,820 bytes (curl -sSL, brand's official site)

fee_veteran.value: $39,600 VetFran for a standard single spa (FDD Item 5, pp.13-14)

fee_existing.value: $39,500 for existing franchisees ($31,600 VetFran) (FDD Item 5, pp.13-14)

fee_developer_package.value: $103,500 standard / $82,800 VetFran for a 3-spa developer package — separate from single-spa economics (FDD Item 5, pp.13-14)

local_advertising.value: 4% of gross sales local advertising, minimum $400/week; combined marketing-fund + local requirement capped at 5% (FDD Item 6, p.15)

risk.arithmetic: 20 (base) + 12 (capital intensity, ceiling $864,729) + 6 (total ongoing 6% royalty + 1% fund + 4% local advertising) + 6 (protected territory but non-exclusive and reducible) + 2 (Item 19 gross-sales only, no profit data) + 2 (2 disclosed litigation matters) - 8 (Item 19 strength: 570 outlets of quartile data) - 4 (615-outlet network scale) - 2 (VetFran $9,900 reduction) - 2 (10+10 term clarity) = 32

components.basis: 6% royalty + 1% fund + 4% local = up to 11% ongoing (FDD Item 6, p.15)
